rows.text: Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning (SITC) of Variable Air Volume (VAV) integrators, complete with the following features and construction: Processor & Programming: Equipped with real‑time clock. Fully programmable for connected devices. Supports advanced VAV programs for comfort optimization and energy savings. Connectivity & Cabling: Communication protocol: BACnet/IP. Maximum of 25 devices per BACnet MSTP. Maximum of 2 loops per integrator. RS485 loop cabling shall be laid horizontally only; crossing of shafts is strictly prohibited. Panel Construction: Compact, modular type, fabricated from 16G CRCA GSS. Totally enclosed, wall‑mounting type, suitable for indoor application. Cable entry as per site conditions, with 12 SWG removable gland plate. Front swing‑type doors; multiple doors provided if single door width exceeds 600 mm. Ventilation louvers for heat dissipation. Lock socket type panel key or nylon door knobs. Two earthing terminals provided, with proper bonding to earthing connections. Integration & Controls: Gateway shall coordinate with AHU BACnet/IP DDC and VAV box operation. Supports scheduling of common spaces. Optimizes ventilation and duct static pressure. Coordinates with Lighting Management System (LMS) and VAV box operation. Safety & Reliability: Proper bonding and earthing for electrical safety. Designed for reliable indoor operation under site conditions.

SITC of VAV thermostats with integrated temperature and CO₂ sensors, installed in all densely occupied areas as per approved shop drawings and specifications. Specifications: Sensor Functions: Integrated temperature sensor. Integrated CO₂ sensor for indoor air quality monitoring. Installation Height: Thermostats to be installed between 3’–6’ above finished floor level (breathing zone). Signal Transmission: CO₂ signal to be transmitted to BMS via BACnet MS/TP protocol.Temperature signal to be transmitted to VAV controller for zone control. Control Logic: CO₂ monitoring ensures demand‑based ventilation. If CO₂ exceeds setpoint, thermostat overrides temperature setpoint and signals VAV to fully open. If CO₂ remains high, fresh air fan speed increases to deliver more outdoor air.
